description: This Java class 'MemoryLeakUtil' provides utility functions to address memory leak issues, specifically focusing on canceling MySQL statement cancellation timers via reflection.

classes.name: MemoryLeakUtil
classes.description: A utility class containing static methods to prevent memory leaks related to MySQL connection timers.

methods.name: shutdownMysqlCancellationTimer
methods.description: Uses reflection to access and cancel the MySQL ConnectionImpl's 'cancelTimer' field, aimed at preventing memory leaks by stopping lingering timers.
